title: NeoVitaDB catalog entry
description: One homebrew entry. Contributors write this file; the build workflow resolves the rest (version, date, size, download count, checksums, download URL) from the GitHub release.

id.description: Stable numeric id, never reused. It is the catalog primary key: the app stores it in the favourites file and uses it to recognise itself. Max 4 digits.

name.description: Homebrew name, without version. The app renders 'name version'.

category.description: Maps to the numeric type the app filters on.

titleid.description: Required for vita entries, ignored for psp. Exactly 9 uppercase alphanumerics.

repo.description: GitHub repository holding the releases, as owner/name.

asset.description: Glob matching the release asset to publish. Defaults to *.vpk.

prerelease.description: Set true to track pre-releases too. Nightly builds should stay false, or every build looks like an update.

icon.description: File name under icons/. The app shards storage by the first two characters, so names must be unique and start with two safe characters.

description.description: Shown in the info panel. May contain newlines. Must never contain the two-character sequence quote-comma, which terminates the field in the on-device parser.

requirements.description: Plain text shown before install. No quotes at all: this field is terminated by the first quote.

screenshots.description: Paths relative to the published catalog root, e.g. screenshots/0001-1.png. Joined with ';' and must fit 511 characters in total.

trailer.description: Base name of an mp4 published under videos/ in the catalog.

data.description: Optional full URL of a separate data-files archive (zip or psarc).

ai.description: Flags homebrew built with AI assistance. Surfaced by a dedicated filter and icon.

trusted.description: Whether the repository has more than TRUSTED_STARS GitHub stars. Written by tools/build_catalog.py itself on every run; do not set this by hand, a scheduled build overwrites it.
